Naaman — captain of the army of the king of Aram (2KI 5:1).

Jehoshaphat — son of Nimshi, father of Jehu (2KI 9:2).
Bidkar — officer of Jehu's army (2KI 9:25).

Jehoahaz — King of Israel, son of Jehu (2KI 10:35).

Joash — King of Judah (2KI 11:21), son of Ahaziah (2KI 11:2). Of the tribe of Judah.
Jehoiada — the priest (2KI 11:9) who protected Joash in his youth (2KI 11:4). Of the tribe of Levi.
Mattan — priest of Baal (2KI 11:18, 2CH 23:17).

Jehozabad — killed King Joash (2KI 12:21).
Shomer — mother of Jehozabad (2KI 12:21), a Moabitess (2CH 24:26).
Amaziah — King of Judah, son of Joash (2KI 12:21). Of the tribe of Judah.

So — King of Egypt (2KI 17:4).

Adaiah — of Bozkath, father of Jedidah (2KI 22:1).
Shaphan — scribe of King Josiah (2KI 22:3, 2CH 34:15).
Azaliah — father of Shaphan (2KI 22:3).
Meshullam — father of Azaliah (2KI 22:3).

Ahikam — son of Shaphan (2KI 22:12).
Achbor — son of Micaiah (2KI 22:12).
Micaiah — father of Achbor (2KI 22:12).
Asaiah — King Josiah's servant (2KI 22:12).

Tikvah — father of Shallum (2KI 22:14).
Harhas — father of Tikvah (2KI 22:14).
Joshua — the governor of Beersheba (?) (2KI 23:8).

Hamutal — mother of Jehoahaz (2KI 23:31).
Jeremiah — of Libnah, father of Hamutal (2KI 23:31).

Zebidah — mother of Eliakim [Jehoiakim] (2KI 23:36).

Mattaniah — King of Judah, uncle of Jehoiachin (2KI 24:17).

Zephaniah — the second-in-charge priest (2KI 25:18) who was killed by the king of Babylon (2KI 25:21). Of the tribe of Levi.

Ishmael — son of Nethaniah, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2KI 25:23).
Nethaniah — father of Ishmael, one of the captains of Judean forces (2KI 25:23).

Kareah — father of Johanan, one of the captains of Judean forces (2KI 25:23).
